§6Station Docking Port§f goes on a deployed space station to let rockets dock and refuel. It is the station-side counterpart to the Docking Pad on the planet surface, providing a return point for crewed and cargo missions.

Craft it shapeless: 1 Battery + 1 Tracking Circuit + 1 Satellite Bay. The port binds to a Space Station ID Chip when placed. Rockets with the same chip automatically home in on the port and dock, transferring fuel and crew.

§ePS:§f Place on the outer hull with a 3x3 air column in front. Multiple ports work but each must be bound to a unique Space Station ID Chip, duplicate bindings cause random docking.
